integrity: The all-dimension statement has an analytic proof. Finite exact-rational checks are auxiliary only. No independent validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Only an existential lower bound and a particular optimized independent-ternary Chernoff construction; no universal optimality or exact clique number; related 2022 survey unavailable in full; possible unindexed prior coverage.
title: Exponential mutual Birkhoff–James cliques in real \(\ell_1^n\)
